newsitem.title: USA: Greif Bros to consolidate operations.
newsitem.headline: Greif Bros to consolidate operations.

text.p: Greif Bros, a maker of industrial packaging and components, said Monday it plans to consolidate its operations effective November 1.

It said most of its wholly-owned subsidiaries, along with all of its operating divisions, will be merged into either the containerboard or shipping containers business units within the parent company.
It said certain key operating personnel will be relocating to the corporate office in Delaware, Ohio.

Certain administratime functions currently performed at the subsidiary and division levels will also be realigned, it said. This will result in some staff reduction, primarily in the administrative and support areas, it said.
The changes will not result in a material change to earnings, it said.

Michael Gasser, chairman and chief executive officer, said that concurrent with the changes, the company will launch a program called Project 2000, which will focus on using information technology to link operations to more effectively serve customers.
